sentences.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普称博·伯格达尔是一个肮脏、腐烂的叛徒，因为他擅自离开了在阿富汗的基地，并建议作为惩罚，应该把他送回去，然后从飞机上扔下来。

sentences.en: On Monday, with Trump now his commander-in-chief, Bergdahl went before a military court that will determine his punishment.
sentences.zh: 周一，随着特朗普现在成为他的三军统帅，伯格达尔出现在军事法庭前，法庭将决定对他的惩罚。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, October 17th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月17日，星期二。

sentences.en: Matt Rosenberg, tell me about what happened on May 31st, 2014.
sentences.zh: 马特·罗森伯格，请告诉我2014年5月31日发生了什么。

sentences.en: President Obama walks out into the Rose Garden.
sentences.zh: 奥巴马总统走进玫瑰园。

sentences.en: Good afternoon, everybody.
sentences.zh: 大家下午好。

sentences.en: And announces that the only POW American soldier held by the Taliban has been freed.
sentences.zh: 并宣布唯一一名被塔利班扣押的美国战俘已经获释。

sentences.en: This morning, I called Bob and Jannie Bergdahl and told them that after nearly five years in captivity, their son Beau is coming home.
sentences.zh: 今天早上，我给鲍勃和珍妮·伯格达尔打了电话，告诉他们，在经历了近五年的囚禁后，他们的儿子博就要回家了。

sentences.en: The soldier is Beau Bergdahl.
sentences.zh: 这名士兵就是博·伯格达尔。

sentences.en: He was freed in a prisoner swap.
sentences.zh: 他是在一次囚犯交换中获释的。

sentences.en: They sent five senior Taliban leaders in exchange for him.
sentences.zh: 他们送出了五名塔利班高级领导人来交换他。

sentences.en: And as part of this effort, the United States is transferring five detainees from the prison in Guantanamo Bay to Qatar.
sentences.zh: 作为这项努力的一部分，美国正在将五名关塔那摩湾监狱的被拘留者转移到卡塔尔。

sentences.en: The Qatari government has given us assurances that it will put in place measures to protect our national security.
sentences.zh: 卡塔尔政府已向我们保证，将采取措施保护我们的国家安全。

sentences.en: At this ceremony is Bergdahl's parents, his father, Bob, and his mother, Jannie.
sentences.zh: 出席这次仪式的有伯格达尔的父母，他的父亲鲍勃和母亲珍妮。

sentences.en: Sergeant Bergdahl has missed birthdays and holidays and the simple moments with family and friends, which all of us take for granted.
sentences.zh: 伯格达尔中士错过了生日、节日以及与家人朋友共度的简单时刻，而这些对我们所有人来说都是理所当然的。

sentences.en: But while Beau was gone, he was never forgotten.
sentences.zh: 但博虽然离开了，却从未被遗忘。

sentences.en: And it's this incredibly dramatic moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个极其戏剧性的时刻。

sentences.en: I mean, there had been years of negotiations for his release.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，为了他的获释，已经进行了多年的谈判。

sentences.en: He had been the focus of manhunts.
sentences.zh: 他一直是搜捕行动的焦点。

sentences.en: He was the sole American soldier held by the Taliban.
sentences.zh: 他是唯一一名被塔利班扣押的美国士兵。

sentences.en: And as you know, the military really does mean it when it says no man left behind.
sentences.zh: 正如你们所知，军队在说“不抛弃任何一个人”时是认真的。

sentences.en: That is part of how they operate.
sentences.zh: 这是他们行动准则的一部分。

sentences.en: He wasn't forgotten by his community in Idaho or the military, which rallied to support the Bergdahls through thick and thin.
sentences.zh: 他的爱达荷州社区和军队并没有忘记他，他们团结一致，风雨同舟地支持着伯格达尔一家。

sentences.en: And he wasn't forgotten by his country because the United States of America does not ever leave our men and women in uniform behind.
sentences.zh: 他的国家也没有忘记他，因为美利坚合众国绝不会抛弃我们的军人。

sentences.en: And Matt, what did President Obama say about the controversial circumstances surrounding the situation that day in the Rose Garden?
sentences.zh: 马特，奥巴马总统那天在玫瑰园对围绕这一局势的争议性情况说了些什么？

sentences.en: He didn't really address it.
sentences.zh: 他并没有真正谈及这一点。

sentences.en: He kept the mood focused on the fact that Sergeant Bergdahl was coming home.
sentences.zh: 他让人们的注意力集中在伯格达尔中士即将回家这一事实上。

sentences.en: Bob and Jannie, today families across America sharing the joy that I know you feel.
sentences.zh: 鲍勃和珍妮，今天全美的家庭都在分享我知道你们所感受到的喜悦。

sentences.en: As a parent, I can't imagine the hardship that you guys have gone through.
sentences.zh: 作为一名家长，我无法想象你们所经历的苦难。

sentences.en: As president, I know that I speak for all Americans when I say we cannot wait for the moment when you are reunited and your son, Beau, is back in your arMs.
sentences.zh: 作为总统，我知道我代表了所有美国人，我们迫不及待地想看到你们团聚，看到你们的儿子博回到你们怀抱的那一刻。

sentences.en: This was something for Americans to celebrate and to be happy about and to be relieved about.
sentences.zh: 这对美国人来说是一件值得庆祝、高兴和感到宽慰的事情。

sentences.en: And that was really the focus of his comments.
sentences.zh: 这确实是他评论的重点。

sentences.en: And I think, you know, if you were watching this at home and didn't know any of the context, you wouldn't necessarily know there was controversy here.
sentences.zh: 我想，如果你当时在家里看直播，且不知道任何背景信息，你未必会知道这里存在争议。

sentences.en: Wonderful.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Of course, this scene in the Rose Garden proved to be a hugely significant and controversial moment.
sentences.zh: 当然，玫瑰园的这一幕后来被证明是一个极其重大且充满争议的时刻。

sentences.en: What was so controversial about the rescue and release of this American soldier?
sentences.zh: 这名美国士兵的营救和获释为何如此具有争议？

sentences.en: You know, Bergdahl was captured at the Taliban because he walked off his base.
sentences.zh: 你知道，伯格达尔被塔利班俘虏是因为他擅自离开了基地。

sentences.en: And his story has been that he believed there were command problems at his base and that his plan,
sentences.zh: 他的说法是，他认为基地存在指挥问题，而他的计划，

sentences.en: this is a story he's told, that he planned to walk to a bigger base about 18 miles away and report his command probleMs.
sentences.zh: 这是他讲述的故事，他计划步行到约18英里外的一个更大的基地，报告他的指挥问题。

sentences.en: Now, the military investigators who interviewed him said that, you know, he was incredibly naive.
sentences.zh: 现在，采访过他的军事调查人员说，他当时非常天真。

sentences.en: He had completely unrealistic expectations for his deployment and what he would be doing.
sentences.zh: 他对自己的部署以及自己将要做的事情有着完全不切实际的期望。

sentences.en: And during the nearly five years he was held, there were moments when anonymous sources often
sentences.zh: 在他被扣押的近五年里，经常有匿名消息来源

sentences.en: raised questions about whether he deserted, whether he had willingly joined the Taliban, had he converted to Islam.
sentences.zh: 提出质疑，问他是否是逃兵，是否自愿加入了塔利班，是否皈依了伊斯兰教。

sentences.en: And there were a lot of people in the military who saw a deserter here and not a prisoner of war.
sentences.zh: 军队里有很多人认为他是个逃兵，而不是战俘。

sentences.en: And in the days kind of following this release, this quickly became a political football, you know.
sentences.zh: 在获释后的几天里，这很快就成了一个政治足球，你知道的。

sentences.en: I've got a lot of questions.
sentences.zh: 我有很多问题。

sentences.en: You know, first and foremost, I spent all week listening to the administration say, you know, we're a country that never leaves their people behind.
sentences.zh: 首先，我整个星期都在听政府说，我们是一个绝不抛弃自己人的国家。

sentences.en: We'll never leave you behind.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不会抛弃你。

sentences.en: That's all well and good, except...
sentences.zh: 这都很好，除了……

sentences.en: You had a Republican strategist, I remember this, because we wrote in one of our stories
sentences.zh: 我记得有一位共和党战略家，因为我们在报道中写过，

sentences.en: and that's still part of the case here and still very much in dispute.
sentences.zh: 这仍然是本案的一部分，而且争议非常大。

sentences.en: You know, when I went through survival training, we talked about the issue of being left behind.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当我进行生存训练时，我们讨论过被抛弃的问题。

sentences.en: It was pretty much an understanding that as long as you don't leave your country behind, your country will never leave you behind, so...
sentences.zh: 当时大家基本达成共识，只要你不背弃国家，国家就永远不会背弃你，所以……

sentences.en: And this is how much of a political issue this case has become.
sentences.zh: 这就是这个案件在多大程度上演变成了一个政治问题。

sentences.zh: 现在回到关于总统用五名顶级恐怖嫌疑人交换

sentences.en: Soldiers on the ground at the time tell CNN that insurgents were able to take advantage of the massive military undertaking to try to rescue Bergdahl,

sentences.en: He didn't want to be found.

sentences.en: And so we were chasing a ghost around eastern Afghanistan for at least 90 days, immediately following his disappearance.
sentences.zh: 所以，在他失踪后的至少90天里，我们一直在阿富汗东部追逐一个幽灵。

sentences.en: That he had hurt the American cause.

sentences.zh: 伯格达尔来自一个叫黑利的地方，在爱达荷州，就在著名的滑雪胜地太阳谷旁边。

sentences.en: And the town had planned on holding a big parade and a celebration for Bergdahl.
sentences.zh: 镇上原本计划为伯格达尔举行盛大的游行和庆祝活动。

sentences.en: And, you know, I went back to that town in January 16, and there were still people there who were occasionally get threats.

sentences.en: He's saying beautiful people were killed trying to find him.

sentences.zh: 这是一个棘手的问题。

sentences.zh: 因为我认为军队里确实有一部分人是这样想的。

sentences.en: There are a lot of others who would say, you know, we found what he did despicable and terrible, but he is one of ours and we need to get him back.

sentences.en: And I think that was the general sentiment that nobody had sympathy for him and they thought he had put people at risk.

sentences.en: He had diverted a ton of their time and their energy and when they were trying to fight a war, but that, yes, he's American and they need to get him back, leaving him in the hands

sentences.en: That's the other side of this equation.

sentences.zh: 我不认为有人会认为那是合适的做法。

sentences.en: out of Bergdahl, said that prison was simply not an appropriate place for Bergdahl to end up.

sentences.zh: 你知道，他不是一个在人生这个阶段应该被关进监狱的年轻人，

sentences.en: know, this was not a young man who deserved to be put in prison at this point in his life,
sentences.zh: 他所受的苦远超任何美国监狱能对他造成的伤害，还有其他处理方式。

sentences.en: that he had suffered far more than any American prison could do to him, and that there are other ways to handle this.
sentences.zh: 我们很多人在《Serial》第二季中听到了伯格达尔用他自己的话描述他在囚禁期间的经历，那一季全是关于这个故事的。

sentences.en: Many of us heard Bergdahl describe his time in captivity in his own words in the second season of Serial, which was all about this story.
sentences.zh: 提醒我们一下，那段经历对他来说是什么样的。

sentences.en: Remind us what that experience was like for him.
sentences.zh: 那太可怕了。

sentences.en: It was horrific.
sentences.zh: 他被关在笼子里好几年。

sentences.en: He was kept in a cage for years.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他的条件越来越差。

sentences.en: You know, his conditions got progressively worse.
sentences.zh: 有殴打，他被像动物一样对待。

sentences.en: There were beatings, and he was treated like an animal.
sentences.zh: 对伯格达尔进行简报的将军说，这种虐待非常严重，是自越南战争以来任何美国士兵遭受的最严重的虐待。

sentences.en: And the general who debriefed Bergdahl said the abuse was so profound that it was the worst abuse sustained by any American soldier since the Vietnam War.
sentences.zh: 他遭受了巨大的痛苦。

sentences.en: He suffered immensely.
sentences.zh: 他们把他关在一个非常黑暗的房间里，听起来几乎像个地下室，那里没有光。

sentences.en: They kind of had you in a really dark room, almost sounded like a basement, like where there was no light.
sentences.zh: 他们把他关在一个非常黑暗的房间里，听起来几乎像个地下室，那里没有光。

sentences.en: Um, yeah.
sentences.zh: 嗯，是的。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Uh-huh.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: The guy.
sentences.zh: 那个人。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: You know.
sentences.zh: 你知道的。

sentences.en: Rich Oppel is covering Bergdahl's trial at Fort Bragg in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 里奇·奥佩尔正在北卡罗来纳州布拉格堡报道伯格达尔的审判。

sentences.en: Just about a few minutes before nine o'clock, he walked into a tiny courthouse on base here at Fort Bragg.
sentences.zh: 就在九点前几分钟，他走进了布拉格堡基地里的一座小型法院。

sentences.en: He looked grim-faced as he walked in, and while he spoke, you know, you could see wrinkles in his forehead.
sentences.zh: 他走进去时神情严峻，说话时，你能看到他额头上的皱纹。

sentences.en: He looked like he was under a lot of pressure and was very serious.
sentences.zh: 他看起来压力很大，而且非常严肃。

sentences.en: So Sergeant Bergdahl was wearing, like all of his military lawyers, his formal dress blue army uniform.
sentences.zh: 伯格达尔中士和他的所有军事律师一样，穿着正式的陆军蓝色礼服。

sentences.en: For most of the proceeding today, he sat at the table with his lawyers, but at a few points, he stood and faced the judge, Jeffrey Nance, a colonel.
sentences.zh: 今天大部分庭审时间里，他都和律师坐在桌旁，但有几次，他站起来面对法官——杰弗里·南斯上校。

sentences.en: So he did look healthier than he's looked before, but he looked like he was under a lot of stress, and he was definitely taking the moment seriously.
sentences.zh: 他看起来确实比以前健康了一些，但看得出他承受着巨大的压力，而且他显然非常认真地对待这一刻。

sentences.en: Rich, what are the charges that Bo Bergdahl faces in court?
sentences.zh: 里奇，博·伯格达尔在法庭上面临哪些指控？

sentences.en: So there are two charges.
sentences.zh: 有两项指控。

sentences.en: One is desertion, which carries a maximum penalty of five years imprisonment, and in the much
sentences.zh: 一项是逃兵罪，最高可判处五年监禁；而另一项更严重的指控是

sentences.en: more serious charge is something called misbehavior before the enemy, which is an old charge and
sentences.zh: 所谓的“在敌人面前行为不当”，这是一项古老的罪名，

sentences.en: one that's rarely used, and in this case, it means he endangered the troops who were sent to search for him after he disappeared.
sentences.zh: 很少被使用。在本案中，这意味着他危及了在他失踪后被派去搜寻他的部队。

sentences.en: So that's interesting.
sentences.zh: 这很有意思。

sentences.en: Desertion is one thing.
sentences.zh: 逃兵罪是一回事。

sentences.en: This misbehavior is another, although it seems like one could necessarily lead to the other, but they're different charges, and the misbehavior is much more serious.
sentences.zh: 这种行为不当是另一回事，尽管看起来前者可能会导致后者，但它们是不同的指控，而且行为不当罪要严重得多。

sentences.en: That's right, but you raise a good point, and one that his chief defense counsel, Eugene
sentences.zh: 没错，但你提出了一个很好的观点，这也是他的首席辩护律师尤金·

sentences.en: Fidel, has made, which is, in his view, the misbehavior before the enemy charge was just a way to essentially charge him twice for the same alleged misconduct.
sentences.zh: 菲德尔所持的观点，即在他看来，“在敌人面前行为不当”的指控，本质上只是为了对同一项所谓的违纪行为进行两次指控。

sentences.en: And so what did Bergdahl do in court on Monday?
sentences.zh: 那么伯格达尔周一在法庭上做了什么？

sentences.en: So the judge began by asking Sergeant Bergdahl if he understood the charges against him and the specific language of each charge, and Sergeant Bergdahl replied that he did.
sentences.zh: 法官首先询问伯格达尔中士是否理解针对他的指控以及每项指控的具体措辞，伯格达尔中士回答说他理解。

sentences.en: Then the judge asked him to talk about what happened after he left the base, and Sergeant
sentences.zh: 然后法官让他讲述离开基地后发生了什么，伯格达尔中士

sentences.en: Bergdahl, among other things, said that he, after 20 minutes, had gotten loSt.
sentences.zh: 提到，除其他事项外，他在20分钟后就迷路了。

sentences.en: The judge asked him to talk about how many times he had tried to escape and to describe
sentences.zh: 法官让他谈谈他尝试逃跑了多少次，并描述一下

sentences.en: some of that, and Sergeant Bergdahl said he had tried to escape 12 to 15 times, he estimated.
sentences.zh: 其中的一些细节，伯格达尔中士估计他尝试逃跑了12到15次。

sentences.en: And he talked about one time, the first day he was captured, where he tried to make a run for it, even though he was chained at the wrist behind his back and blindfolded, but he
sentences.zh: 他谈到了其中一次，即被俘的第一天，他试图逃跑，尽管当时他的手被反铐在背后，眼睛也被蒙住，但他

sentences.en: was tackled by villagers.
sentences.zh: 还是被村民扑倒了。

sentences.en: And another time where he was on the run for eight days, and he frantically tried to wave at drones, American drones above him, to try to get the drone operators to recognize
sentences.zh: 还有一次他逃亡了八天，他疯狂地试图向头顶的无人机——美国无人机挥手，试图让无人机操作员认出

sentences.en: who he was and to send help.
sentences.zh: 他的身份并派人救援。

sentences.en: But that never happened.
sentences.zh: 但那从未发生。

sentences.en: Rich, why do you think that the judge was asking the questions he was asking?
sentences.zh: 里奇，你认为法官为什么要问这些问题？

sentences.en: What might he have been trying to get at by asking Bergdahl how many times he tried to escape from the Taliban?
sentences.zh: 他通过询问伯格达尔从塔利班手中逃跑了多少次，到底想了解什么？

sentences.en: Well, I think he was really trying to understand Bergdahl's motivation and intent and his frame of mind.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我认为他真的在试图了解伯格达尔的动机、意图和心理状态。

sentences.en: And definitely he was trying to get a sense of whether Bergdahl was doing what he's supposed to be doing as a captive American soldier.
sentences.zh: 他肯定是在试图弄清楚伯格达尔作为一名被俘的美国士兵，是否在做他应该做的事。

sentences.en: And that's been the testimony consistently on this for several years.
sentences.zh: 几年来，关于这一点一直有持续的证词。

sentences.en: The Army's own investigator, General Dahl, that talked to Bergdahl when he got back, was
sentences.zh: 陆军自己的调查员达尔将军在伯格达尔回来时与他谈过，

sentences.en: really clear in the preliminary hearing two years ago that Bergdahl did what he was supposed to do to try to resist and try to get away when he could from his captors.
sentences.zh: 他在两年前的预审听证会上非常明确地表示，伯格达尔确实尽了他应尽的努力，试图反抗并尽可能从俘虏手中逃脱。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: One of the initial questions was, is this someone who somehow aligned himself with the Taliban?
sentences.zh: 最初的问题之一是，这个人是否在某种程度上与塔利班结盟了？

sentences.en: The fact that he tried to escape many times would suggest not.
sentences.zh: 他多次尝试逃跑的事实表明并非如此。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's one thing that's been pretty well disproven.
sentences.zh: 是的，这一点已经被相当充分地反驳了。

sentences.en: And in fact, General Dahl believed the story that Bergdahl told him in their interview in
sentences.zh: 事实上，达尔将军相信伯格达尔在2014年的采访中告诉他的故事，

sentences.en: 2014 that, you know, that was not what was at issue.
sentences.zh: 你知道，那并不是问题的关键。

sentences.en: I mean, he was trying to get to this other base to complain about problems that he perceived within his own unit.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他当时是想去另一个基地，去投诉他认为自己部队内部存在的问题。

sentences.en: And it was nothing about trying to desert or join the Taliban or anything like that.
sentences.zh: 这与试图当逃兵或加入塔利班之类的行为毫无关系。

sentences.en: And General Dahl was pretty emphatic about that during that testimony.
sentences.zh: 达尔将军在作证时对此非常强调。

sentences.en: Did he express any regret for what he did and what kind of mobilization it caused within the military, which remains such a controversial element of all this?
sentences.zh: 他是否对自己所做的事情以及这在军队内部引发的动员——这仍然是所有这些事件中极具争议的一部分——表达了任何遗憾？

sentences.en: He did.
sentences.zh: 他表达了。

sentences.en: He said at one point he described it as inexcusable and he understood that he had broken the law.
sentences.zh: 他在某个时刻称其为不可原谅，并表示他明白自己触犯了法律。

sentences.en: As the morning wore on, the hearing reached a climax and he pled guilty to the two charges.
sentences.zh: 随着上午的推移，听证会达到了高潮，他承认了这两项指控。

sentences.en: And then the gravity of the moment really sank in, I'm sure, not just on Sergeant Bergdahl, but on everybody in the courtroom.
sentences.zh: 我相信，那一刻的沉重感不仅压在伯格达尔中士心头，也压在法庭上的每个人心头。

sentences.en: The judge asked him if he understood that among the penalties he would now face with his guilty pleas were life in prison.
sentences.zh: 法官问他是否明白，随着他的认罪，他现在面临的惩罚包括终身监禁。

sentences.en: And the sergeant said, yes, sir.
sentences.zh: 中士回答说，是的，长官。

sentences.en: And then the judge asked both the prosecution and the defense, is there any agreement as part of these guilty pleas to limit his punishment?
sentences.zh: 然后法官问控辩双方，作为认罪协议的一部分，是否有任何限制他惩罚的协议？

sentences.en: And both sides said no.
sentences.zh: 双方都说没有。

sentences.en: And so he then turned again to Sergeant Bergdahl and said, well, knowing this, are you sure you want to plead guilty?
sentences.zh: 于是他再次转向伯格达尔中士说，那么，在了解这一点的情况下，你确定要认罪吗？

sentences.en: And he said yes.
sentences.zh: 他说确定。

sentences.en: So the judge is just making sure that Bergdahl understands that by pleading guilty to these two charges that you've described, that he may spend the rest of his life in prison.
sentences.zh: 所以法官只是在确保伯格达尔明白，通过承认你所描述的这两项指控，他可能会在监狱里度过余生。

sentences.en: And then the defense and the prosecutor, that they all agree that the punishment could be that severe.
sentences.zh: 辩方和检察官也都同意，惩罚可能会如此严厉。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Rich, what happened to the defense's argument that Trump's statements made it impossible for Bergdahl to have a fair trial?
sentences.zh: 里奇，辩方关于特朗普的言论使伯格达尔无法获得公正审判的论点怎么了？

sentences.en: Why didn't that come up in court on Monday?
sentences.zh: 为什么周一在法庭上没有提到这一点？

sentences.en: Well, the judge ruled in February that while President Trump's comments were, quote, disturbing, he didn't see a reason to dismiss the charges.
sentences.zh: 嗯，法官在二月份裁定，虽然特朗普总统的评论是“令人不安的”，但他没有看到驳回指控的理由。

sentences.en: And he did not think that those comments had prejudiced the case.
sentences.zh: 他认为这些评论并没有对案件造成偏见。

sentences.en: And what else has Bergdahl's defense team been arguing that will still be a factor in the case as it heads into sentencing?
sentences.zh: 在案件进入量刑阶段时，伯格达尔的辩护团队还在争论哪些因素？

sentences.en: Well, it's been a number of things.
sentences.zh: 嗯，有很多方面。

sentences.en: One thing was that Sergeant Bergdahl's diagnosed mental health issues should be taken into account.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是伯格达尔中士被诊断出的心理健康问题应该被考虑在内。

sentences.en: And they had laid a lot of the blame for what happened on the army itself, questioning whether
sentences.zh: 他们将所发生事件的大部分责任归咎于军队本身，质疑

sentences.en: Sergeant Bergdahl ever should have been enlisted in the first place.
sentences.zh: 伯格达尔中士是否应该从一开始就被征召入伍。

sentences.en: The defense team had also argued that in addition to there not being any evidence of soldiers being
sentences.zh: 辩护团队还辩称，除了没有任何证据表明有士兵在搜寻过程中

sentences.en: killed during the search, that a handful of service members who were wounded badly during the search, that their wounds could not be directly linked to Sergeant Bergdahl.
sentences.zh: 丧生之外，在搜寻过程中受重伤的几名军人，他们的伤势也无法直接与伯格达尔中士挂钩。

sentences.en: Because in one case, on one operation, a military investigation later found that the operation had been very poorly planned.
sentences.zh: 因为在其中一个案例中，在一次行动中，军事调查后来发现该行动计划得非常糟糕。

sentences.en: And in another case, the operation appeared to be a dual purpose mission, according to the defense team, that it was not just to get Sergeant Bergdahl, but it was also to target
sentences.zh: 而在另一个案例中，据辩护团队称，该行动似乎是一个双重目的的任务，不仅是为了找到伯格达尔中士，也是为了针对

sentences.en: a well-known Taliban insurgent.
sentences.zh: 一名知名的塔利班叛乱分子。

sentences.en: So finally, Rich, what happens next to Bergdahl?
sentences.zh: 最后，里奇，伯格达尔接下来会怎样？

sentences.en: A sentencing hearing is scheduled to begin next Monday, where prosecutors will put on evidence for why there should be a stiff punishment for Sergeant Bergdahl.
sentences.zh: 量刑听证会定于下周一开始，届时检察官将提交证据，说明为什么应该对伯格达尔中士进行严厉惩罚。

sentences.en: At the same time, the defense will make a couple of counterarguments.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，辩方将提出一些反驳意见。

sentences.en: They are expected to argue that the extraordinary torture that Sergeant Bergdahl suffered during his years in captivity reflect profound consequences for what he has done already.
sentences.zh: 预计他们会辩称，伯格达尔中士在被俘期间遭受的非人折磨，已经对他所做的事情产生了深远的影响。

sentences.en: So in a lot of ways, the case really is about sort of two conflicting thoughts.
sentences.zh: 所以在很多方面，这个案件实际上是关于两种相互冲突的思想。

sentences.en: One is that, you know, you never leave your unit, you never leave your fellow soldiers.
sentences.zh: 一种是，你知道，你永远不能离开你的部队，永远不能离开你的战友。

sentences.en: But on the other hand, the military, as President Obama pointed out that very first day in the
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，正如奥巴马总统在第一天在

sentences.en: Rose Garden, right after Sergeant Bergdahl had been returned to the U.S., you know, the military never leaves soldiers behind.
sentences.zh: 玫瑰园所指出的那样，就在伯格达尔中士被送回美国后，你知道，军队从不抛弃任何士兵。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And so those two things did seem to be in conflict here.
sentences.zh: 所以这两件事在这里似乎确实存在冲突。

sentences.en: And depending on how the hearing goes next week, it could be very fateful for Sergeant Bergdahl.
sentences.zh: 根据下周听证会的情况，这对伯格达尔中士来说可能是决定命运的。

sentences.en: On Monday afternoon, during a news conference at the White House, President Trump was asked
sentences.zh: 周一下午，在白宫举行的新闻发布会上，特朗普总统被直接问及

sentences.en: directly if his comments as a candidate might have affected Bergdahl's ability to receive a fair trial.
sentences.zh: 他作为候选人时的评论是否可能影响了伯格达尔获得公正审判的能力。

sentences.en: And can you respond to his attorney's claim?
sentences.zh: 你能回应他律师的说法吗？

sentences.en: I can't comment on Bo Bergdahl because he's, as you know, they're, I guess he's doing something today, as we know.
sentences.zh: 我不能评论博·伯格达尔，因为正如你所知，他们，我想他今天在做些什么，我们都知道。

sentences.en: And he's also, they're setting up sentencing.
sentences.zh: 而且他也在，他们正在安排量刑。

sentences.en: So I'm not going to comment on him.
sentences.zh: 所以我不会评论他。

sentences.en: But I think people have heard my comments in the paSt.
sentences.zh: 但我认为人们已经听过我过去的评论了。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了吗？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费试用《时报》一个月，而且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，获得30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他内容。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I just want to say that we just spent quite a bit of time inside with the Senate Majority
sentences.zh: 我只想说，我们刚刚和参议院多数党

sentences.en: Leader Mitch McConnell, who has been a friend of mine for a long time, long before my world of politics, early into his world of politics, I think.
sentences.zh: 领袖米奇·麦康奈尔在里面待了很长时间，他是我认识很久的朋友，远在我进入政治世界之前，我想是在他进入政治世界早期时认识的。

sentences.en: After months of bitter disagreements and name-calling, President Trump and Senate Majority Leader Mitch
sentences.zh: 经过数月的激烈分歧和互相指责，特朗普总统和参议院多数党领袖米奇·

sentences.en: McConnell walked into the Rose Garden on Monday, began an impromptu news conference, and declared themselves close allies.
sentences.zh: 麦康奈尔周一走进玫瑰园，开始了一场即兴新闻发布会，并宣布他们是亲密的盟友。

sentences.en: Well, thank you very much, Mr. President.
sentences.zh: 嗯，非常感谢，总统先生。

sentences.en: I want to underscore what the president said.
sentences.zh: 我想强调总统所说的话。

sentences.en: We have the same agenda.
sentences.zh: 我们有相同的议程。

sentences.en: We've been friends and acquaintances for a long time.
sentences.zh: 我们是相识已久的朋友和熟人。

sentences.en: We talk frequently.
sentences.zh: 我们经常交谈。

sentences.en: We don't give you a readout every time we have a conversation, but frequently we talk on the weekends about the issues that are before us.
sentences.zh: 我们不会在每次谈话后都向你们汇报，但我们经常在周末讨论摆在我们面前的问题。

sentences.en: Trump has repeatedly mocked McConnell for failing to pass legislation.
sentences.zh: 特朗普曾多次嘲笑麦康奈尔未能通过立法。

sentences.en: We are probably now, despite what we read, we're probably now, I think, at least as far as I'm concerned, closer than ever before.
sentences.zh: 尽管我们读到了什么，但我们现在可能，我认为，至少就我而言，比以往任何时候都更亲近。

sentences.en: And earlier this year, an observatory in Washington state detected an unusual signal coming from a small constellation of stars in outer space.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，华盛顿州的一家天文台探测到了来自外太空一个小恒星群的异常信号。

sentences.en: Soon after, a global team of astronomers spotted a new pinprick of light in the night sky.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，一个全球天文学家团队在夜空中发现了一个新的光点。

sentences.en: It faded from blue to red and then vanished.
sentences.zh: 它从蓝色褪为红色，然后消失了。

sentences.en: On Monday, scientists revealed what they had heard and seen.
sentences.zh: 周一，科学家们揭示了他们所听到和看到的内容。

sentences.en: Today, we're thrilled to announce that scientists have detected gravitational waves coming from the collision of two neutron stars, the smallest and densest stars.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们很高兴地宣布，科学家们探测到了来自两颗中子星——即最小、密度最大的恒星——碰撞产生的引力波。

sentences.en: This event occurred 130 million light-years from Earth in a galaxy far away.
sentences.zh: 这一事件发生在距离地球1.3亿光年的遥远星系中。

sentences.en: For the first time, astronomers had observed the collision of such stars, which is believed
sentences.zh: 天文学家首次观测到了此类恒星的碰撞，据信

sentences.en: to have played a key role in the formation of the universe and is responsible for creating almost all of the world's precious metals, including uranium, silver, and gold.
sentences.zh: 这在宇宙形成中发挥了关键作用，并负责创造了世界上几乎所有的贵金属，包括铀、银和金。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直作为一个严密控制的机器运作，直到今年

sentences.en: summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 夏天，选举迎来了一群自称改革者的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，该党就陷入了一场伤痕累累、混乱不堪，有时又令人兴奋的斗争中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在《Metro》的最新一集中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《Metro》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在你获取播客的任何地方收听。
